system_deps: MuJoCo 2.1 binaries and a C compiler for mujoco-py
install.notes: The gate and the fake backend need neither mujoco nor mujoco_py: fake.py is a package-local stand-in for the mujoco module the MuJoCo bridge imports. Install MuJoCo 2.1 and mujoco-py only to run the upstream simulator, which was not run here.
